item.title: DISTRICT 2 GIRLS BASKETBALL: Hazleton Area repeats as Class 6A champs
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — These Hazleton Area singers can play a little basketball. Their friends are pretty good at the game, too. item.description: WILLIAMSPORT – If you get through the PIAA Class 2A Northeast Regional at Williamsport High School, it’s a sign of potential success at the state championship at the Giant Center in Hershey. item.title: DISTRICT 2 BOYS BASKETBALL: Abington Heights uses size to claim fourth straight 5A title
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — The immediate energy Crestwood brought to start the District 2 Class 5A boys basketball championship game was something Mark Atherton felt needed to happen. Eventually, Abington Heights’ size and experience proved to be the difference. Abington Heights won its fourth consecutive Class 5A district championship with a 57-37 win over Crestwood on Friday night at Mohegan Arena. item.title: NE REGIONAL WRESTLING: Spindler, Benyos advance to 3A semis
item.description: BETHLEHEM — Last season, Brody Spindler battled illness and fell short of qualifying for states. Now, the Pittston Area senior wrestler is off to a perfect start at the Class 3A Northeast Regional. item.title: AHL: Penguins hold on for win in Cleveland
item.description: CLEVELAND — The Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins got off to a good start in their weekend trip to Cleveland. The Pens jumped out to a 2-0 lead after one period, and held on in the final minutes for a 3-2 win over the Monsters Friday night at Rocket Arena. The two teams will square off again Saturday to finish the weekend doubleheader.
